fields.title: Identifier
fields.description: Unique identifier for the launched tab item.

fields.title: Table tab
fields.description: Reference to the open table tab that contains this launched item.

fields.title: Menu item
fields.description: Reference to the selected menu item.

fields.title: Quantity
fields.description: Number of units of the menu item launched on the tab.

fields.title: Preparation note
fields.description: Optional preparation instruction for this launched item.

fields.title: Unit price
fields.description: Price per unit recorded when the item is launched.

fields.title: Status
fields.description: Current status of the launched tab item.

lineTotal.description: Total amount for this item, calculated from its quantity and recorded unit price.

transitions.description: Cancels an item launched by mistake while its table tab remains open.
